The '''E3-standard starship lifeboat''',<ref name="USW" /> or simply the '''E3 Escape Pod''',<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a type of [[escape pod]]<ref name="USW" /> manufactured by [[His Grace the Duke Gadal-Herm's Safety Inspectorate]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles 2018" /> [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] used one in his journey to the [[planet]] [[Dagobah]] to live in [[Great Jedi Purge|exile]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="USW" /><ref name="CVNE">''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
The pod had four main legs that used clamp locks to prevent sliding. Tractor Field Restraints were used to hold the occupants. The [[Starship|ship]] had a slow [[engine]], even for a civilian vessel, only having 300G thrust. Illuminated steps on the landing ramp also ensured visibility in dark landing zones.<ref name="CVNE" />

==Usage by Yoda==
Although small, the craft afforded reasonable living space for beings of [[Yoda]]'s stature. The lifeboat served as Yoda's initial shelter during his [[Exile (punishment)|exile]] on [[Dagobah]], providing a convenient camp with protection from the torrential rains, pests, and predators. However, it started to degrade within a [[Standard year|year]] due to Dagobah's [[swamp]]y environment. As the first shelter was consumed by the swamp, Yoda built a new [[Yoda's Hut|home]] for himself (using several cannibalized parts from the pod) and lived there until his [[death]].<ref name="USW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The E3-standard starship lifeboat would have appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] in a scene where Yoda travels to Dagobah on board the [[Starship|ship]].<ref name="ROTS DVD">Deleted scenes section from the DVD release of {{Film|III}}</ref> However, the scene was cut in the final compilation of the film. The [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] uses a footage from the deleted scene in Yoda Biography Gallery, in which the lifeboat is visible.<ref name="Yoda Biography">{{Databank|yoda-biography-gallery|Yoda Biography Gallery}}</ref> The name of the boat was confirmed to be [[canon]] in ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'', a reference book released in [[April 28]], [[2015]].<ref name="USW" />
